Player travels from BOTTOM upward through the entire panel. Each third must have its own environmental detail and depth but connect naturally to the next third, no hard horizontal lines. Open central flight corridor; rich environmental silhouettes along edges. Uppermost and lowermost 8 percent should have simple atmospheric gradients and sparse details that can feather into adjacent panels. TOP EDGE pale peach blue sky suitable to join cloud realm. BOTTOM has water and mist. Preserve charming warm golden-green reference palette and world identity.
